jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. This belongs to the party's archivist guide — it should read as careful, orderly and protective, the work of someone who keeps records, never wild or violent. Even the final dissipation frame must still show a clearly visible shape, never fade to nothing. The effect is a hanging archive lantern that flares and casts a wide protective dome of warm light. Frame 1 the lantern glass brightens from within. Frames 2-4 the light opens outward in broad tiers, carrying faint drifting page-fragments in its glow. Frame 6 the light reaches its widest as a low warm dome with a bright rim, sheltering rather than striking. The dome must be painted as SOLID warm light all the way through - opaque golden haze, not a transparent glass bubble - and its interior must never be left empty or see-through. Absolutely no green, teal or blue-green anywhere inside or around the dome: every part of the glow stays gold, honey, cream or amber. Frames 7-8 the dome settles and thins to a steady halo. Palette: warm lamplight gold and honey, aged brass, cream paper, soft amber shadow.
